# Stationery Point

> Retail and wholesale stationery shop at Janatha Junction, Vyttila, Kochi. School supplies, office supplies, art materials, and custom corporate diaries below MRP.

## Products & Services
- [Wholesale Stationery](https://stationerypoint.in/wholesale-stationery-kochi): Bulk stationery with volume pricing and GST invoices for schools and offices
- [Office Stationery](https://stationerypoint.in/office-stationery-kochi): Copier paper, files, staplers, whiteboards, pens, and printer ink
- [Art & Craft Supplies](https://stationerypoint.in/art-and-craft-supplies-kochi): Canvas, acrylics, brushes, sketchbooks, and craft material
- [School Stationery](https://stationerypoint.in/school-stationery-kochi): Notebooks, pens, pencils, pouches, bags, and student kits packed on request
- [Corporate Diaries 2027](https://stationerypoint.in/corporate-diaries-kochi): Custom printed 2027 diaries with company logo from 100 units
- [Return Gifts](https://stationerypoint.in/return-gifts-kochi): Birthday and event return gifts tailored to budget
- [Catalogue](https://stationerypoint.in/catalog): Browse full stationery and art catalogue

## Location & Areas Served
- [Kakkanad & Infopark](https://stationerypoint.in/stationery-kakkanad-infopark): Office stationery supply for Infopark companies
- [Panampilly Nagar](https://stationerypoint.in/stationery-shop-panampilly-nagar): School stationery and art supplies near Panampilly Nagar
- [Vyttila NH Bypass](https://stationerypoint.in/stationery-shop-vyttila-nh-bypass): Stationery shop near NH 66 bypass with free parking
- [About Stationery Point](https://stationerypoint.in/about): Store location at Ground Floor, Katti Tower, Janatha Junction, Vyttila
